title: We Finally Know Tyrannosaurus Rex’s Body Temperature - Nautilus
gist: UCLA-led geobiologists determined Tyrannosaurus rex's internal body temperature from a single tooth donated by Thomas the T. rex at the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County, using a technique needing 90% less sample.
